correctness.rationale: The source CDF gives \(G(y)\sim C y^\gamma\) at zero with \(C=[(1+\alpha)\theta/\alpha]^\gamma\), hence \(h(y)\sim\gamma C y^{\gamma-1}\). A first-order expansion at infinity gives \(1-G(y)\sim\gamma\alpha(1+\alpha)^{-1}e^{-\theta y}\) and \(g(y)\sim\gamma\alpha\theta(1+\alpha)^{-1}e^{-\theta y}\), so \(h(y)\to\theta\). The four Figure 1 exclusions then follow from endpoint order and nonnegativity. The packaged checker verifies the CDF derivative and endpoint ratios at high precision.

value.rationale: Hazard-shape flexibility is a central advertised feature of the NOT-Exp model and Figure 1 is the source's direct evidence for all four headline reliability patterns. The endpoint theorem shows that each chosen example is incompatible with its assigned global shape, so the issue changes aging/failure-rate interpretation and parameter guidance rather than merely correcting a plotting label. The universal long-run limit \(h(\infty)=\theta\) also gives a useful structural reliability property absent from the source.
